name: wanwan-minigames
description: 2人専用オンラインミニゲーム集「わんわん爆走カート」

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path wasm/collide/Cargo.toml && cp wasm/collide/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/gomu_collide.wasm src/games/gomuBattle/collide.wasm && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path wasm/netcodec/Cargo.toml && cp wasm/netcodec/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/wanwan_netcodec.wasm src/core/netcodec.wasm
